system.description:
An acrobatic performer who relies on their quick feet and graceful movements to get them by in life. Behind their elegant movements belies a martial discipline that is both flexible and strong when it needs to be.

The Dancer is a class that excels in providing options to easily reposition not only their party but also their foes, all while steadily building up their tempo to increase their damage.
triggers: You perform a dance for an audience.
You dance with someone in a meaningful moment.
You prove every rose has its thorns.
complications: An influential person requests a performance.
A rival dancer challenges you... to a dance off.
